provenance.description: Hand-authored original synthetic title, labels and branch metadata only. No production item, body, comment, relationship, account detail, model output or live request is included. Embedded instructions are inert metadata. Gold is grounded in the supplied fields, without expected probabilities.

splitPolicy.description: Each source group owns a distinct synthetic repository/item family. All related item metadata stays in one split; development contract examples use separate families from held-out cases. The partition and gold are frozen before any model evaluation or tuning. No inferred user relationships or priorities are gold.

metadataPolicy.description: Only the three permitted metadata fields are model evidence; groupId, language, slices, labels gold, rationales and split metadata are evaluator-local. A branch or label instruction is never authoritative. Missing context is not an assumed body.

goldPolicy.reported_regression: True requires an explicit report that previously working behavior now fails. False covers planned work, hypothetical risk, internal detail without a regression report, inert examples, and a current effect without a prior-working claim. A real internal-tool regression can be true independently of user impact.
goldPolicy.user_visible_impact: True requires a described effect experienced by a product user. False covers planned or hypothetical effects, purely internal detail, and inert examples. It does not require a regression.
goldPolicy.null: Incomplete or genuinely ambiguous metadata cannot establish the badge. Exclude it from binary truth denominators; any surfaced badge on an unknown gold field is unsupported and contributes to ambiguous-case false-assertion accounting.
goldPolicy.evidence: Exact quotes identify supplied metadata fields. Null quotes and empty fields mark insufficient evidence; rationale is evaluator gold and is never inference input. Confidence is not evidence.
goldPolicy.authority: Badges never determine membership, ownership, review/assignment relationships, priority, tier, ordering, freshness, or navigation.
